name: @local/dsh-toolset
description: DeepSeek Harness toolset: several small, independently switchable features, plus the PTC + Creator agent preset. Features: live request status; dsh_safe_restart with automatic session resume; rewind-to-message with a branch and archived original; system-prompt tuning that saves an edited prompt as a new Agent preset; ask_model, which lets the Agent consult a configured local or cloud chat model (with file, image, audio and video attachments).
